en: <t1>One merge at a time, and no plan survives it.</t1> The executor's step takes no plan. It observes the forge, decides, observes again, and acts only if the second decision names the same master and head and still says <t2/>. <t3/> is a loop over that step. There is no variable in which a candidate list could survive a merge. A merge is then proved where it landed: the first-parent successor of the decided master must be this merge, with the decided head as its second parent; anything else is <t4/>, even when the forge calls the pull request merged. The forge-side half of that guard is the protection's <t5/>; the executor reports a base without it and cannot set it (D8). An unverified merge holds every later drain until a person acknowledges it (D7); an interrupted merge is verified, never repeated, before the next decision.
cs: <t1>Jeden merge najednou a žádný plán ho nepřežije.</t1> Krok exekutoru nepřijímá žádný plán. Neexistuje proměnná, ve které by seznam kandidátů mohl merge přežít. Merge se poté dokazuje tam, kde přistál: první-rodičovský následník rozhodnutého masteru musí být tento merge a rozhodnutý head jeho druhým rodičem; cokoli jiného je <t4/>, i když forge označí pull request jako sloučený. Strana této záruky na forge je <t5/> ochrany; exekutor hlásí základ bez ní a nastavit ji neumí (D8). Neověřený merge zadrží každé další vyprázdnění, dokud ho člověk nepotvrdí (D7); přerušený merge se před dalším rozhodnutím ověří, nikdy neopakuje.

en: A crate binary states only what ran. <t1/> prints <t2/> on the result line of a binary that ran nothing at all, so the recorder reads the counts, not only the word: a binary with a failed test is a failure whatever its word says; one that passed nothing (every test ignored, or none there) or ran only a subset a name filter chose is a skip, the absence of a proof rather than a proof; one whose result line carries no count, or that printed no result line before the next binary, is an error, because the harness could not say what ran. Colour codes are stripped from every line before it is matched, so a coloured run reads as a plain one. What the output held that no claim can name yet is listed, with the reason, in the recording's <t3/> list (a <t4/> line in the text output) rather than ignored: the crate's own unit-test binary (<t5/>), its doctests (<t6/>), a binary outside <t7/>, and a <t8/> line with no <t9/> line before it, which is never credited to the previous binary.

en: One open session per provider session, not per worktree: a second window of the same provider gets an episode of its own under state/sessions-open/, and session-current.yaml points at the episode of this checkout. The open record is never tracked. A closed record is an envelope of references selected by the session stamp on each ledger line, never by a time range. start freezes the resolved context into the local working-context store as an opening snapshot, and `session context` composes the live working context on every read instead of returning that file: the episode's identity, git now against git at the open, and the checkpoints, decisions and questions the episode recorded, taken from the ledger lines carrying its own session id. `--path` prints the snapshot instead. A closed record's body is composed the same way and is never empty; where the episode recorded nothing authored, the record says so and names the command that would have recorded it. --if-open and --if-none are what let a provider hook run the open and the close on every event. archive moves the oldest closed records beyond the policy's session.retention_max_files into the section's archive/ directory, only when it is run and only when session.archive is true; it deletes nothing and refuses before the first move when a record of that name is already archived.

Otevřený záznam se nikdy nesleduje v gitu. Uzavřený záznam je obálka odkazů vybraných podle razítka relace na každém řádku knihy, nikdy podle časového rozsahu. start zmrazí vyřešený kontext do lokálního úložiště pracovního kontextu jako úvodní snímek a `session context` při každém čtení skládá živý pracovní kontext, místo aby vracel tento soubor: identitu epizody, git nyní proti gitu při otevření a kontrolní body, rozhodnutí a otázky, které epizoda zaznamenala, vzaté z řádků knihy nesoucích její vlastní id relace. `--path` vytiskne místo toho snímek.
